chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abu Ali, the companion of Al-Shaeer, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Musa (peace be upon him): 'Among My servants is one who draws near to Me through a good deed, so I will judge him to be in Paradise.' Musa (peace be upon him) said: 'O Lord, and what is that good deed?' He (Allah) said: 'He walks with his believing brother in fulfilling his need, whether it is fulfilled or not fulfilled.'
ai.seo_question: What specific good deed did Allah reveal to Musa (AS) as a means of drawing near to Him and entering Paradise?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Allah reveals to Prophet Musa (AS) that accompanying a believing brother to fulfill his needs—whether the need is met or not—is a deed so beloved that Allah 'judges' the servant for Paradise, highlighting the immense spiritual weight of social solidarity. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on *ta'alluq* (spiritual connection) through practical assistance, where the intention and companionship in service are valued as highly as the successful resolution of the matter. It serves as a foundational text for the virtue of *qada' al-hawaj* (fulfilling needs), linking individual piety directly to communal welfare.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ali Sahib of Al Shaeer, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Musaas: “From Myazwj servants there is one who comes nearer to Meazwj by the good deeds so Iazwj Judge him to be in the Paradise”. So Musaas said: ‘O Lordazwj! And what is that good deed?’ Heazwj Said: “Walking with his Momin brother regarding fulfilment of his need, whether it gets fulfilled or does not get fulfilled”’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ali Sahib al-Sha’ir from Muhammad ibn Qays from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, sent revelations to Moses that said, ‘Of My servant there are those who perform a good deed seeking thereby nearness to Me and I help him to rule in paradise.’ Moses then asked, ‘Lord, what is that good deed?’ Allah said, ‘He walks with his brother (in belief) to help his wish come true, whether it then comes true or not. ’”
